name: Furious Styles
caption: Sinister and the Professional, lifelong friends managed by the Professional's father, who drifted apart in late 2001 until they met for Sinister's AWP Heavyweight title.

name: The Conceptuals
caption: Neil and Janice, an art-studio couple whose Yorkshire accents surface when they turn violent, AWP Tag Team Champions in late 2001.

tenures.source: The federation's own 2001 cards, roleplays and bulletins, 6 November 2001 to 3 December 2001.

name: The Mexican Mafia 200
caption: El Loco and Enrique, beaten by the Conceptuals on Total Darkness in November 2001.

tenures.source: The federation's own 2001 documents of 6 November 2001.

name: Young, Rich, and Infamous
caption: Steve Sexton and Kendall Trapp, a squabbling pair of rich young heels disqualified with the champions in their AWP Tag Team title match of November 2001.

tenures.source: The federation's own 2001 cards, roleplays and bulletins, 14 November 2001 to 3 December 2001.

name: Cheat to Win
caption: The Emerald City Kidd's stable with Young, Rich, and Infamous, formed in November 2001.

tenures.source: The federation's own 2001 cards, roleplays and bulletins, 14 November 2001 to 25 November 2001.

name: The Prizefighters
caption: Orion Massacre and Blackjack, self-appointed big brothers of the roster, sidelined on Orion's injury in November 2001.

tenures.source: The federation's own 2001 cards, roleplays and bulletins, 10 June 2001 to 3 December 2001.

name: Reign of Terror
caption: Sinister, The Big Chill and Trey Lawrenze, a stable The Big Chill traces to a five-man founding, reunited in November 2001.

notes: The same two wrestlers are billed as the South Syndicate Soldiers in the federation's Weekly Update of 10 June 2001.
caption: Kenneth Morlock and Matt Allen, called the uncrowned champions because they were never pinned for the titles, who lost their AWP Tag Team title shot to the Conceptuals in December 2001.
